y-m-12-05.title: Imigqa emibili engahlangani iyahambisana?
y-m-12-05.topic: Imigqa emibili ehambisanayo (ibanga phakathi kwemigqa ehambisanayo)
y-m-12-05.goal: Qonda ukuthi ukungahlangani ngaphakathi kwephepha akwanele ukuqinisekisa ukuhambisana, bese uvuselela isinqumo sakho ucabangela iphutha ekukaleni kwebanga.
y-m-12-05.material: Umugqa 가 nomugqa 나 kudwetshwe ephepheni. Ufuna ukuthola ukuthi imigqa emibili iyahambisana yini. Ibanga phakathi kwemigqa emibili ehambisanayo ubude obukalwe ngqo kumugqa 가, futhi buyafana noma ukala kuphi. Cabanga ukuthi ukukala ngomthetho kunephutha elingaba ngu-0.2 cm. Kala ibanga ezindaweni ezingu-5 cm ukude ngomugqa 가. Isithombe asikhonjiswanga.
y-m-12-05.thinking.0: Ukuvuselela isinqumo sakho isikhathi ngasinye lapho idatha inyuka

y-m-12-05.prereq.1: Ibanga phakathi kwemigqa emibili ehambisanayo liyafana noma ukala kuphi
y-m-12-05.s.s1.prompt: Idatha embulwa ucezu olulodwa ngesikhathi. Isikhathi ngasinye, khetha lokho okucabangayo.
y-m-12-05.s.s1.hint.0: Esinyathelweni ngasinye, hlukanisa lokho idatha entsha ekutshela 'ngokuqinisekile' nalokho ekuvumela 'ukuqagela' kuphela.
y-m-12-05.s.s1.hint.1: Ukusho ukuthi amabanga acishe afane yini, qhathanisa umehluko nephutha elingu-0.2 cm.
y-m-12-05.s.s1.st.0.info: Ngaphakathi kwephepha, imigqa emibili ayihlangani. Awukwazi ukunweba imigqa ngale komphetho wephepha.

y-m-12-05.s.s1.st.0.r.a: 'Ayihlangani ngaphakathi kwephepha' no-'ayihlangani nanini noma inwetshwa kude kangakanani' kuhlukile.

y-m-12-05.s.s1.reflect: Ekuqaleni waqala nge-'asikwazi ukunquma', ngedatha yesibili 'ithuba lokuhambisana' lanyuka, futhi ngedatha yesithathu isinqumo sakho sashintsha ngenye indlela saba ngu-'ayahambisani'. Qaphela ukuthi nakuba idatha itholwe ngendlela efanayo, isinqumo sakho sashintsha kuye ngokuthi umehluko wawukhulu noma mncane kunephutha.
y-m-12-05.s.s2.prompt: Izindlela ezingaki kulezi ezilandelayo ezenza ubufakazi bokuthi 가 no-나 bayahambisana buqine? Khetha zonke ezifanele.

y-m-12-05.s.s2.r.b: Ukukala ezindaweni eziningi, ungahlunga iphutha noma ithuba endaweni eyodwa noma ezimbili.
y-m-12-05.s.s2.o.c: Dweba umugqa owodwa odlula kokubili 가 no-나 bese uhlola nge-set square ukuthi zombili ama-engeli ziyi-engeli elungile

y-m-12-05.s.s2.o.d: Hlola ukuthi imigqa emibili ingubukhulu obufanayo yini
y-m-12-05.s.s2.explain: Ukwandisa izindawo ozikalayo nokuhlola ukuthi zombili zime ngqo emugqeni owodwa kwenza ubufakazi bokuhambisana buqine. Ukuzwa ngamehlo noma ngobukhulu kuhlobene ngokubuthaka kuphela nokuhambisana.
y-m-12-05.s.s2.acc.0: Ukwandisa izindawo ozikalayo kuphela kwenza ubufakazi buqine. Ukuhlola nokuma ngqo nakho kungcono nakakhulu.

y-m-12-01.title: I-protractor inemigqa emibili yamamaki futhi iyadida
y-m-12-01.topic: Ukukala usayizi wekhona nge-protractor (ukufunda imigqa emibili yamamaki)
y-m-12-01.goal: Thola isilinganiso sokunquma ukuthi iyiphi inombolo okufanele uyifunde emigqeni emibili yamamaki ku-protractor, bese ulungisa ukufunda okungalungile ngokukuhlola ngosayizi olinganiselwe.
y-m-12-01.material: UMinjae ukala usayizi wekhona ㅅㅇㅈ (시옷 이응 지읒), eladwetshwe ephepheni, nge-protractor. Ulandelanise isikhungo se-protractor ne-vertex ㅇ, futhi walandelanisa uhlangothi ㅇㅅ nophawu lwe-0° ohlangothini lwesokudla lwe-protractor. Ebheka lapho uhlangothi ㅇㅈ ludlula khona, amamaki angafundwa emigqeni emibili. Ukufunda umugqa oqala ku-0° wesokudla kunika 65, futhi ukufunda umugqa oqala ku-0° wesobunxele kunika 115. Leli khona libukeka lincane kunekhona elilungile (ikhona elilungile le-set square). Isithombe asikhonjiswanga, ngakho cabanga izindawo ezichazwe ngamagama.
y-m-12-01.thinking.2: Ukuhlola ukuthi uma isimo sishintsha, indlela efanayo inika umphumela ohlukile

y-m-12-01.s.s1.line.1: Landelanisa uhlangothi ㅇㅅ nophawu lwe-0° ohlangothini lwesokudla lwe-protractor.
y-m-12-01.s.s1.line.2: Uphawu uhlangothi ㅇㅈ olukhomba kulo lungafundwa emigqeni emibili, lunika 65 no-115.
y-m-12-01.s.s1.line.3: 115 inombolo enkulu futhi ivelele kakhulu, ngakho ngikhetha u-115.

Uhlangothi ㅇㅅ lwalandelaniswa ne-0° yesokudla, ngakho kufanele ufunde umugqa oqala ku-0° wesokudla, futhi lokhu kuhambisana nesilinganiso sokuthi ikhona lincane kunekhona elilungile. Umugqa 5 umphumela odlulisa iphutha lomugqa 4.
y-m-12-01.s.s2.prompt: Ngikale elinye ikhona ngendlela efanayo. Kulokhu futhi, uhlangothi olulodwa lwalandelaniswa ne-0° yesokudla, futhi leli khona libukeka libanzi kakhulu kunekhona elilungile. Ukufunda umugqa oqala ku-0° wesokudla kunika 105, futhi ukufunda umugqa oqala ku-0° wesobunxele kunika 75. Yiliphi inani elifanele?

y-m-12-13.title: Inyanga ephakeme kakhulu nenyanga enokwanda okukhulu kakhulu
y-m-12-13.topic: Ukuhlukanisa inani eliphakeme kakhulu nesikhawu esinokwanda okukhulu kakhulu kugrafu womugqa
y-m-12-13.goal: Hlukanisa 'inani likhulu kakhulu' no-'lishintshe kakhulu', yenza ithebula elenza izinguquko zilula ukuziqhathanisa, bese wenza idatha yakho lapho izimo ezimbili zihlukile.
y-m-12-13.material: UDaeun udwebe ugrafu womugqa wenani labahambeli ngenyanga (iyunithi: abantu) emtapweni wedolobha lakubo. NgoJanuwari 40, Febhuwari 90, Mashi 130, Ephreli 150, Meyi 160. Amaphoyinti aphawulwe inyanga ngayinye futhi amaphoyinti aseduze axhunywe ngezingxenye zomugqa. UDaeun uphendule umbuzo othi 'Iyiphi inyanga eyanda kakhulu?' njengoba kungezansi. Kunephutha kulesi sixazululo.
y-m-12-13.s.s1.prompt: Khetha umugqa oyedwa ongalungile esixazululweni sikaDaeun.
y-m-12-13.s.s1.hint.0: Bhala phansi, oyedwa ngesikhathi, umehluko obonisa ukuthi inyuke ngabantu abangaki phakathi kwezinyanga ezimbili eziseduze ngasinye.
y-m-12-13.s.s1.hint.1: Qhathanisa ukuthi ukuthola iphoyinti eliphakeme kakhulu nokuthola ingxenye enyuka kakhulu kuyinto efanayo yini.
y-m-12-13.s.s1.line.2: Kusuka ku-Ephreli kuya kuMeyi ingxenye iya phezulu ngakwesokudla, ngakho kuyiqiniso ukuthi inyukile.
y-m-12-13.s.s1.line.3: Kusuka kuJanuwari kuya kuFebhuwari yasuka ku-40 yaya ku-90, ngakho ayizange inyuke kakhulu.
y-m-12-13.s.s1.explain: Umugqa 2 awulungile. Inyanga enenani eliphakeme kakhulu nenyanga enokwanda okukhulu kakhulu ingase ingafani. Umugqa 4 nawo awulungile. Kusuka kuJanuwari kuya kuFebhuwari yakhula ngabantu abangu-50, okuwukwanda okukhulu kakhulu phakathi kwezinyanga eziseduze (Febhuwari→Mashi abantu abangu-40, Mashi→Ephreli abantu abangu-20, Ephreli→Meyi abantu abangu-10).
y-m-12-13.s.s2.prompt: UDaeun ufuna ukwengeza umugqa owodwa kuthebula ukuze aqhathanise 'ukuthi ikhule kangakanani inyanga ngayinye' ngokubuka kanye. Yimuphi umugqa ofaneleke kakhulu?
y-m-12-13.s.s2.hint.0: Qala unqume ukuthi lokho ofuna ukukwazi 'usayizi' noma 'inguquko'.
y-m-12-13.s.s2.hint.1: Hlola ukuthi umugqa ngamunye usitshela umehluko phakathi kwezinyanga yini.
y-m-12-13.s.s2.r.a: Uma ubhala umehluko nenyanga edlule inyanga ngayinye, ungaqhathanisa inguquko ngokushesha.
y-m-12-13.s.s2.o.b: Isamba senani labahambeli kuzo zonke izinyanga
y-m-12-13.s.s2.r.b: Isamba sitshela okuphelele kodwa asibonisi inguquko phakathi kwezinyanga.
y-m-12-13.s.s2.r.c: Inyanga enabaningi kakhulu ingabonakala kakade kugrafu, futhi ayisizi ekuqhathaniseni inguquko.

y-m-12-13.s.s2.explain: Uma ubeka 'ukwanda uma kuqhathaniswa nenyanga edlule' njengomugqa, ungaqhathanisa inguquko phakathi kwezinyanga ngokushesha. Imigqa ebonisa usayizi wamanani ayinamsebenzi omncane ekuqhathaniseni inguquko.

y-m-12-04.title: Izisekelo zokusho 'zonke izimo ezinezinhlangothi ezine'
y-m-12-04.topic: Ukuqhathanisa izisekelo ezichaza isamba sama-engeli amane esimo esinezinhlangothi ezine

y-m-12-04.material: USua noJunho bakhuluma ngokuthi 'isamba sama-engeli amane esimo esinezinhlangothi ezine singu-360°' silungile yini kuzo zonke izimo ezinezinhlangothi ezine. Cabanga kuphela ngezimo ezinezinhlangothi ezine ezingenayo indawo ephakathi iya ngaphakathi. USua: 'Ngikale izimo ezinezinhlangothi ezine ezi-5 nge-protractor futhi ngengeza ama-engeli amane, ngathola 359°, 361°, 360°, 362°, 358°. Ngakho isamba sazo zonke izimo ezinezinhlangothi ezine singu-360°.' UJunho: 'Uma udweba i-diagonal eyodwa kusimo esinezinhlangothi ezine, sihlukana sibe onxantathu ababili. Isamba sama-engeli amathathu kanxantathu oyedwa singu-180°, ngakho isamba sama-engeli amane esimo esinezinhlangothi ezine singu-360°.'

Ikilasi ngalinye linabantu abangu-20 sekukonke, futhi iKilasi 가 kumele libe nebhola lezinyawo ngokucacile ngaphezu kwamanye amabili, futhi iKilasi 나 kumele libe nebhasikidi ngokucacile ngaphezu kwamanye amabili. Ethebuleni elihlanganisiwe, i-dodgeball nayo kumele ibe ngokucacile ngaphezu kwamanye amabili.
y-m-12-12.s.s2.hint.0: I-dodgeball kumele ibe yeyesibili ngobuningi, eseduze neyokuqala, emakilasini womabili. Qala ubeke i-dodgeball yekilasi elilodwa ibe abantu abangu-1~2 abambalwa kunowokuqala.
y-m-12-12.s.s2.hint.1: Bala izamba zebhola lezinyawo, ibhasikidi ne-dodgeball lapho kuhlanganisiwe, bese uhlola ukuthi i-dodgeball ingeyinkulu kunazo zonke yini.

y-m-12-12.s.s2.ok.c3: EKilasini 가, ibhola lezinyawo lingelinengi kakhulu.
y-m-12-12.s.s2.fail.c3: EKilasini 가, ibhola lezinyawo alinengi kunamanye amabili.
y-m-12-12.s.s2.fail.c4: EKilasini 나, ibhasikidi alinengi kunamanye amabili.
y-m-12-12.s.s2.fail.c5: Ethebuleni elihlanganisiwe, i-dodgeball ayiyiningi kunebhola lezinyawo noma ibhasikidi.
y-m-12-12.s.s2.explain: Isibonelo, uma iKilasi 가 line-bhola lezinyawo 8, ibhasikidi 5, i-dodgeball 7 futhi iKilasi 나 line-bhola lezinyawo 5, ibhasikidi 8, i-dodgeball 7, ithebula elihlanganisiwe liyibhola lezinyawo 13, ibhasikidi 13, i-dodgeball 14, ngakho i-dodgeball iyokuqala. Okokuqala ekilasini ngalinye kungase kungabi okokuqala ethebuleni elihlanganisiwe.
y-m-12-12.s.s3.prompt: Lo mphumela ukutshela ini ngombono othi 'uma wazi okokuqala ekilasini ngalinye, ungazi okokuqala ebangeni lonke'? Bhala nokuthi yiluphi ulwazi odinga ukuluyazi ukuze wazi okokuqala ebangeni lonke.
y-m-12-12.s.s3.hint.0: Ethebuleni olenzile, hlola ukuthi i-dodgeball yayiyiphi indawo ekilasini ngalinye.
y-m-12-12.s.s3.hint.1: Bheka ukuthi izinombolo zezinto ezingezona ezokuqala nazo zisetshenzisiwe lapho kutholwa isamba yini.
y-m-12-12.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingabe uxhumanise isitatimende esithi 'okokuqala ekilasini ngalinye akusikho njalo okokuqala ebangeni' nesibonelo sakho sezinombolo?
y-m-12-12.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingabe usho ukuthi ulwazi oludingekayo yizo zonke izinombolo zabantu ngento ngayinye ekilasini ngalinye (hhayi okokuqala kuphela)?
y-m-12-12.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ingabe ibandakanya isitatimende sokuthi uhlola ngokwengeza?
y-m-12-12.s.s3.model.0: Awukwazi ukusho ukuthi okokuqala ekilasini ngalinye nakho kuyokuqala lapho kuhlanganisiwe. Esibonelweni sami, i-dodgeball yayiyeyesibili emakilasini womabili, kodwa lapho ngihlanganisa yaba yokuqala. Ukwazi ibanga lonke, kumele wengeze izinombolo ngento ngayinye zamakilasi amabili bese ubheka.
y-m-12-12.s.s3.model.1: Noma into iyokuqala ekilasini ngalinye, umphumela ohlanganisiwe ungashintsha. Udinga ukwazi zonke izinombolo zabantu ngento ngayinye, hhayi okokuqala kuphela, futhi udinga ukwengeza amanani amakilasi amabili ezinto ezifanayo bese uqhathanisa.
